WITH daily AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS d,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM orders.orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-09-20'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-09-22'
  GROUP BY 1
),
window_stats AS (
  SELECT cnt AS value, cnt AS n
  FROM daily
  WHERE d = DATE '2017-09-21'
),
baseline_stats AS (
  SELECT cnt AS baseline, cnt AS n_baseline
  FROM daily
  WHERE d = DATE '2017-09-20'
),
spread_calc AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 2 THEN STDDEV(cnt) ELSE NULL END AS spread
  FROM daily
  WHERE d >= DATE '2017-09-20' AND d < DATE '2017-09-21'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(w.value, 4) AS value,
  ROUND(b.baseline, 4) AS baseline,
  ROUND(s.spread, 4) AS spread,
  w.n,
  b.n_baseline
FROM window_stats w, baseline_stats b, spread_calc s;
